sloka: भृशम् आव्रजमानस्य तस्य अधो वाम लोचनम् ।प्रास्फुरत् च अस्खलत् रामो वेपथुः च अस्य जायते ॥३-६०-१॥
transliteration: bhṛśam āvrajamānasya tasya adho vāma locanam ।prāsphurat ca askhalat rāmo vepathuḥ ca asya jāyate ॥3-60-1॥

translations.english: As Rama was returning( to the hermitage), his left eye throbbed repeatedly and he stumbled and his body trembled.
